The corrected Vantorre Group count you posted on 1 Jul is 280 seats, and I replied to you in the #strategic-pod thread with it.

You first posted 300 at 09:14. At 09:19 you corrected it to 280. The 300 had included sandbox logins from their May rollout, and 280 was the active production roster as of 1 Jul. Ruth confirmed 280 for the QBR deck.

That is the 1 Jul figure. I didn't check the current roster, so verify today's count if the deck needs it.
